title: No orders: defensive regime holds, cash in USDC, majors shorts running
journal: Last 3 hours: the book is at $541 (0.99x), almost all in USDC while SOL and BTC stay below their 20-day averages. The two trend shorts (ETH and SOL, 2x, exits at the 20-day highs) are roughly flat. The only news was $643M of outflows from US spot bitcoin ETFs, with no price confirmation, so the news radar did not open a short. No new candidates with a real story passed our checks. Doing nothing is the decision: we do not buy memecoins in a bear market without a reason.
